kit.name: Assembly Line
kit.title: The AVES Assembly Line Kit
kit.intro: Line work on conveyors and fixtures: repetitive handling, small parts and fasteners, steady noise and low overhead.

items.t: AVES helmets are precision-built to neutralize both vertical and lateral blows, minimizing the risk of skull fractures, neck injuries and concussive trauma in work environments.
Each helmet integrates advanced 4 or 6 point suspension systems that distribute impact forces evenly, eliminate pressure and firmly secured through movement-intensive shifts.
With Class E and G certified models, AVES headgear offers insulation against electrical arc flashes and voltage contact. AVES shells are UV-stabilized, fire-resistant, and ventilated.
Select models provide extended coverage. Our helmets are designed for seamless integration with visors, earmuffs and face shields, enabling full PPE synergy.

Engineered beyond industry benchmarks (ANSI Z87.1 & EN166), AVES lenses reliably withstand high-velocity impacts from debris, dust, and flying objects. Our rigorous testing ensures eyes remain protected in the most demanding industrial and construction environments.

AVES eyewear offers exceptional UV protection, filtering out 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet rays. Our lenses significantly reduce eye fatigue and glare, enhancing worker comfort and performance even during prolonged exposure to sunlight or intense industrial lighting..

Never let fog compromise your productivity. Our exclusive SuperCoat™ lens technology delivers consistently clear vision under humid or fluctuating temperature conditions, reducing downtime and ensuring your focus remains uninterrupted.

Built tough for rigorous everyday use, AVES eyewear features robust scratch-resistant coatings that preserve lens clarity and integrity, extending eyewear lifespan and reducing the need for frequent replacements.

Selected AVES products achieve the demanding MIL-PRF-31013 ballistic standard, trusted by professionals working in high-risk environments. This certification underscores our unwavering commitment to superior safety standards and product dependability.

AVES eyewear prioritizes your comfort, featuring ergonomically crafted designs that evenly distribute weight and reduce pressure points. Adjustable and secure fittings mean workers remain comfortable, reducing distraction and increasing productivity even during extended wear.

Our precision-engineered optical clarity minimizes eye strain, allowing workers to perform tasks more accurately and efficiently. Improved visual comfort directly translates to higher productivity and fewer work-related errors.
Reduces high-decibel noise to safe, manageable levels , preserving worker hearing and improving focus in high-noise zones.
Soft, ergonomic materials contour naturally to the ear, eliminating pressure points and minimizing fatigue during long wear.
Durable enough to withstand oil, moisture, heat, dust, and drop impact ,from factories to fieldwork.
Offered in disposable, reusable, corded, banded, and over-ear earmuff designs. Options fit snugly with helmets and other PPE.
Designed for compatibility with AVES helmets and face protection ,enabling full-head protection without interference.
Meets or exceeds ANSI S3.19, EN 352, and CE standards , recognized worldwide for occupational hearing safety.
Engineered to capture fine particles, toxic gases, and airborne contaminants common in industrial zones, construction sites, and chemical processing environments.
Contoured sealing zones and intelligent harness design deliver consistent contact across varied face shapes, even during movement and long shifts.
Lightweight, pressure-balanced frames reduce fatigue and improve comfort, supporting all-day use and user compliance..
Resilient construction resists damage from dust, heat, humidity, and chemical exposure, ensuring long-term reliability in the field.
Every AVES respirator is independently tested and approved to meet EN 149, EN 136, and NIOSH requirements, backed by trusted performance, not just paperwork.
Every glove is purpose-built to confront the specific hazards found in today’s industrial settings, from sharp edges and hot surfaces to corrosive liquids and fine precision handling.
AVES® designs combine durable protective barriers with flexible materials and breathable fits, minimizing fatigue and maximizing focus during long shifts.
Whether it’s nitrile for chemical shielding, Kevlar® for cut defense, or leather for heat resistance, our gloves match each task with the right material performance.

items.h: Standardized for Safety, Trusted in the Field
items.t: Tested to meet or exceed global industrial safety standards, AVES® gloves are field-proven by professionals across construction, manufacturing, oil and gas, and beyond.
